title: GridLayout
oneLiner: grid 컨테이너 — cols·gap 프롭 + auto-fit/auto-fill/min-child-width 자동 칼럼(R12 단일 구현).

web.code:
<jd-grid-layout cols="{cols}" gap="{gap}">
  <jd-box p="3" bg="card" radius="md" border>1</jd-box>
  <jd-box p="3" bg="card" radius="md" border>2</jd-box>
  <jd-box p="3" bg="card" radius="md" border col-span="2">colSpan=2</jd-box>
</jd-grid-layout>

<!-- 반응형 칼럼 · 자동 칼럼(우선순위 auto-fit > auto-fill > min-child-width > cols) -->
<jd-grid-layout cols="1 md:3" gap="4">…</jd-grid-layout>
<jd-grid-layout auto-fit="220" gap="4">…</jd-grid-layout>
